  hibp [command] [options]

  auth          Manage the API key.

  stealerlogs   Search stealer logs.
  paste         Search exposed pastes.
  subscription  Inspect subscription capabilities.
  password      Search Pwned Passwords without sending a complete password or hash.

  Check passwords using local SHA-1 hashes and k-anonymity.

Usage:
  hibp password check [options]

Options:
  --stdin                          Read one password line from stdin. The line terminator is excluded.
  --file <file>                    Read one password per line from a UTF-8 text file.
  -p, --parallelism <parallelism>  Maximum concurrent file lookups. Defaults to logical processor count (minimum 2). Use 1 for sequential checks.
  --json                           Write JSON results (the default).
  --markdown                       Write Markdown results instead of JSON.
  --outfile <outfile>              Write results to this file instead of stdout.
  --force                          Replace an existing output file.
